summary: Eight concrete, comment-endorsed tools, media picks, and devices surfaced from a verified complete HN comment crawl.
telegram_footer: 8 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: BetterMouse
items.summary: A macOS mouse utility for configurable MX Master gestures and controls.
items.why_included: A long-term MX Master user named it as their personal replacement for Logitech software.
items.evidence: The commenter reports using BetterMouse on macOS with an MX Master mouse.

evidence_sources.author: jsalama
evidence_sources.excerpt: Personally I've been using BetterMouse on macOS with my MX Master, although it's not open source.

items.name: Virological podcast — Cancer vaccines: How the immune system learns to recognize tumors
items.source_story_title: Moderna reports first positive Phase 3 for mRNA neoantigen therapy in melanoma
items.summary: A podcast episode explaining how cancer vaccines train immune recognition of tumors.
items.why_included: A listener explicitly called the episode great in a thread on mRNA cancer vaccines.
items.evidence: A commenter recommended the episode after listening to it the prior month.

evidence_sources.author: MartinMond
evidence_sources.excerpt: I listened to a great podcast on this just a month ago

items.name: Steve Mould
items.summary: A YouTube channel focused on clear science and engineering videos.
items.why_included: A commenter gave the channel an unambiguous personal endorsement.
items.evidence: The commenter called Steve Mould someone to love and linked directly to the channel.

items.name: Metamath

items.summary: A community repository for formalized mathematical proofs and results.

items.name: Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B
items.summary: A local mixture-of-experts model used for fast web-scraping tasks.
items.why_included: A first-hand user found it competitive with a larger Qwen model while running faster.
items.evidence: The user reported being impressed by its speed and results in web-scraping work.

evidence_sources.author: jonesy827
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using the 35B-A3B today for some web scraping work, and it has been on par with Qwen3.8 27B at a much higher speed and at a higher quant (q4 vs q8). I'm impressed.

items.name: Garmin Instinct
items.summary: A rugged smartwatch line with activity, HRV, and body-battery analytics.
items.why_included: A long-term wearer said the Garmin Instinct meets their needs and praised its detailed analytics.
items.evidence: The wearer specifically said the watch hits the spot and called its HRV and daily-battery analytics awesome.

items.name: Pebble Time 2
items.summary: A revived color e-paper smartwatch with a touchscreen and heart-rate monitor.
items.why_included: A current wearer gave the smartwatch an unusually direct, enthusiastic personal endorsement.
items.evidence: The commenter said they keep wearing a Pebble Time 2 and absolutely love it.

evidence_sources.author: SyneRyder
evidence_sources.excerpt: Me, I'll keep rocking my Pebble Time 2. Absolutely love it.

items.name: SQLite
items.summary: An embedded SQL database suited to simple, low-concurrency applications.
items.why_included: A commenter gave an unqualified first-hand endorsement for their own scale despite known writer limits.
items.evidence: The commenter said they use SQLite for everything and are perfectly happy with it at their scale.

evidence_sources.author: replwoacause
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use SQLite for everything, and I'm perfectly happy with it.
